name: Amstrad GX4000
description: Amstrad's only games console, released in Europe in 1990 and based on its CPC Plus computers. It added hardware sprites and a 4,096-colour palette to the CPC design, but arrived as 16-bit consoles took over and was dropped within about a year.

specs.memory: 64 KB (16 KB used as video RAM)
specs.graphics: Amstrad custom ASIC, hardware sprites, 4,096-colour palette

curiosities: Only 27 games were released for it.
Burnin' Rubber was bundled with the console.
Its cartridges also work in the 6128 Plus and 464 Plus computers.
bestsellers: Barbarian II: The Dungeon of Drax
